envelope.description: Add the attach module with commit-pinned links

body.title: Add the attach module with commit-pinned links
body.summary: Add src/workflow/tracker/attach.ts with the permalink (blob/<last commit that touched the file>/<path> on the repository's GitHub host) and attachDocuments(unit, port, targets, deps): refuse a dirty or untracked file, skip an Attachment already recorded for (target, revision), find a link already posted through listComments and record it without posting again, otherwise port.attach and record an Attachment { target, revision, at, externalId } on the head of the unit's own artifact; honour the staged-write check; record the module in ARTIFACT_WRITE_INVENTORY.
acceptanceChecks: the link names the last commit that touched the rendered file and a new commit adds a new link while the old attachment stays
a dirty or untracked file, an unbound unit and a failing tracker are reported in failed[] and nothing is posted or recorded for them
a link found in listComments is recorded as reconciled and not posted again, and a recorded (target, revision) is skipped with no tracker call
the write inventory has an entry for the module and its test passes

tests.name: attach.test.ts: attachDocuments builds a link to the file at the last commit that touched it, refuses a dirty or untracked file, skips a recorded (target, revision), adds a new link for a new commit and keeps the old attachment, and records a link found already posted without posting it again
artifact-write-inventory.test.ts: the write inventory lists the binding and attach writers as meta-only writers of meta.envelope and every production writer file still has an entry
